news.title: McDavid has 2 goals and 3 assists in the Oilers' 6-2 romp over the Mammoth
news.ruTitle: На счету Макдэвида 2 гола и 3 передачи в матче «Ойлерз» над «Мамонтом» со счетом 6:2.
news.description: — Connor McDavid had two goals and three assists and the Edmonton Oilers beat the Utah Mammoth 6-2 on Saturday night to split a home-and-home series.

news.title: Golden Knights rout Penguins 6-2 as Mark Stone nets a goal and 2 assists
news.ruTitle: «Голден Найтс» разгромили «Пингвинз» со счетом 6:2, Марк Стоун забил гол и сделал 2 результативные передачи
news.description: — Mark Stone had a goal and two assists, and the Vegas Golden Knights extended their strong start by romping past the slumping Pittsburgh Penguins 6-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Which player has the most career points in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Какой игрок набрал наибольшее количество карьерных очков в истории НХЛ?
news.description: Wayne Gretzky leads the list of NHL players with the most career points. Check out other top performers now.

news.title: Who has scored the most goals in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Кто забил больше всего голов в истории НХЛ?
news.description: Alex Ovechkin holds the record for the most individual career goals in NHL history. Which other players are at the top of the list?

news.title: Kent Johnson scores in OT as Blue Jackets beat Rangers 1-0 behind Jet Greaves' shutout
news.ruTitle: Кент Джонсон забивает в овертайме, когда «Блю Джекетс» обыграли «Рейнджерс» со счетом 1:0 после нокаута Джета Гривза
news.description: — Kent Johnson scored with 1:33 remaining on the clock in overtime, Jet Greaves got his fifth career shutout and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New York Rangers 1-0 on Saturday night.

news.title: Forsberg scores first of the season as the Predators beat the Blues 5-2
news.ruTitle: Форсберг забивает первый гол в сезоне, когда «Хищники» обыграли «Блюз» со счетом 5–2.
news.description: — Filip Forsberg scored a goal and added an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 5-2 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.

news.title: Michkov and Martone lead Flyers past Senators 3-1 for 1st win of season after 9-game skid
news.ruTitle: Мичков и Мартоне обыграли «Флайерз» сенаторов со счетом 3:1 и одержали первую победу в сезоне после провала в 9 играх
news.description: — Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone each had a goal and an assist, and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Ottawa Senators 3-1 on Saturday night for their first victory this season.

news.title: Caufield scores his second goal in OT to lift Canadiens over Sabres 4-3
news.ruTitle: Кофилд забивает свой второй гол в овертайме, победив «Канадиенс» над «Сэйбрз» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Cole Caufield scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime to lift the Montreal Canadiens over the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Still awaiting trade, Connor Hellebuyck could rejoin Jets when suspension ends
news.ruTitle: Все еще ожидая обмена, Коннор Хеллебак может вернуться в Джетс, когда дисквалификация закончится.
news.description: Still awaiting a potential trade, Winnipeg players are preparing for difficult conversations should star goaltender Connor Hellebuyck, a former NHL MVP and three-time Vezina Trophy winner, rejoin the Jets next week when his suspension is expected to end.

news.title: Lucas Raymond scores in shootout as Red Wings rally for 4-3 win over Sharks
news.ruTitle: Лукас Рэймонд забивает в серии пенальти, когда "Ред Уингз" одержали победу над "Шаркс" со счетом 4:3
news.description: — Lucas Raymond scored the only goal during the shootout and the Detroit Red Wings rallied for a 4-3 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday night.

news.title: Ehlers’ power-play winner lifts Hurricanes past Jets 3-2 for 7th straight win
news.ruTitle: Победитель Элерса в большинстве обыграл «Харрикейнз» «Джетс» со счетом 3:2 и одержал седьмую победу подряд
news.description: — Nikolaj Ehlers scored a power-play goal 6:43 into the third period to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to their seventh straight victory, 3-2 over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday.

news.title: Bo Horvat scores winner and adds assist in Islanders' 4-1 win over Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Бо Хорват забил победный гол и сделал результативную передачу в победе «Айлендерс» над «Мэйпл Лифс» со счетом 4:1.
news.description: — Bo Horvat scored the winner and added an assist to help the New York Islanders beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-1 on Saturday night.
